item.title: Taylor Swift & Travis Kelce Thanked by More Than a Dozen Charities Following $26 Million Pre-Wedding Donation: ‘Kindness Never Goes Out of Style’
item.description:
[Intro music plays]
Host: "Welcome to our podcast, where we're shining a light on the latest news and trends in the music industry. I'm your host, and today we're talking about a truly generous act by none other than Taylor Swift and her fiancé, Travis Kelce.
[Soft music continues in the background]
Host: "As they prepare to tie the knot over the Fourth of July weekend, the couple has made a stunning $26 million donation to various charities across the United States. And the responses from these organizations are truly heartwarming.
[Clip of a charity's thank-you message plays]
Host: "The Grammy Museum Foundation, for example, called their gift 'transformative', saying it will help expand their mission of bringing music education to students nationwide. Meanwhile, New York Cares expressed their enchantment with the couple's generosity, thanking them for making their mission part of their love story.
[Clip of Dolly Parton's video message plays]
Host: "Even the legendary Dolly Parton chimed in, thanking Taylor and Travis for donating $2 million to her Imagination Library, which provides free books to children. 'It's evident that you two have made giving back a key part of your lives,' she said.
[Soft music continues]
Host: "What's remarkable is that the couple chose charities in cities that hold personal significance to them, including Reading, Pennsylvania, Cleveland, Nashville, and Kansas City. And, of course, New York City, where they're set to celebrate their wedding at Madison Square Garden.
[Outro music plays]
Host: "That's all for today, folks. A huge thank you to Taylor Swift and Travis Kelce for inspiring us all with their kindness and generosity. We'll be back with more music news and trends soon. Until then, keep on shining!"
[Outro music continues to play until the end]
